objective: Test decode-then-track execution on frozen arm and beam scenes and acquire additional source-group beam candidates
execution_adapter: Project decoded joint angles into native limits, then retain original first 0.6 s and quintic blend to decoded angles by 1.2 s; root uncompressed. Thereafter use decoded joint reference through the end.
adapter_caveat: Teacher-assisted common-entry scaffold; not standalone full-clip codec execution or a student motor-token interface. Record projection and transition corrections.
qualification: Both continuations pass every empty-scene perturbation under existing task/tracking criteria; additionally compare measured tracking to original continuous reference using unchanged 10 cm body / 25 cm root limits
frozen_scene_rule: Reuse existing critical/relaxed/removed/displaced geometry unchanged across methods, including geometry-predicted failures; no scene adaptation to decoded motion
source_selection: Up to six new source groups ranked by kinematic similarity to qualified walk carriers; original tuck, 4 cm drop plus waist pitch 0.35, and pure waist pitch 0.50; all construction failures retained
source_main_selection: At most two source groups with all-perturbation qualified alternatives and ensemble-admitted beam geometry
